setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 through the test MIDI device: four trigs on steps 1-4 (C, D, E, F = MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65; velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) in C major. Every trig has its normal chance of sounding. The Trig params screen is open on its parameter list, showing Fixed Note; no slot is assigned yet. Fixed Note is used here to pin the pitch, so that you hear only which trigs play, not which note.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Fixed Note to the first slot and K2 to return, then turn E3 to 65 (F3): every note is now F3. Turn E2 to the next slot and open the Trig Probability picker.
steps.title: Fix the pitch, then find Trig Probability

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Trig Probability and K2 to return. The selected slot reads X until you set its channel value.
steps.title: Assign the probability slot

steps.caption: Set the selected Trig Probability slot to 100 and check its readout before auditioning the phrase.
steps.title: Confirm the channel probability

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Trig Probability and K2 to return, then turn E3 up to 100. Tap Play (1,8) and tap it again to stop: the MIDI strip lists all four steps at pitch 65 with velocities 127, 117, 107, 97. Then turn E3 up a few more detents; the value stays at 100. Play and stop again: every trig still sounds.
steps.title: 100 plays every trig, and nothing goes above it

steps.caption: With no step held, set Trig Probability to 0 and confirm the slot readout has no L lock marker.
steps.title: Confirm zero chance on the channel

steps.caption: Tap Play and confirm the transport indicator turns on before the bounded audition window.
steps.title: Start the zero-probability audition

steps.caption: Tap Play/Stop again and confirm the transport indicator turns off.
steps.title: Stop the zero-probability audition

steps.caption: At 0, none of the four trigs plays a note. Compare this with 100, where every trig plays.
steps.title: 0 is a certain rest

steps.caption: While step 2 is held, the Trig Probability slot reads 100 with an L marker.
steps.title: Confirm the step-two override

steps.caption: After step 2 is released, the channel probability remains 0.
steps.title: Confirm the channel value after release

steps.caption: Hold step 2 at (2,4), turn E3 all the way down and then up to 100, and release. That lock beats the channel's 0. Tap Play: only step 2 sounds, once per loop, at velocity 117. The channel value is still 0.
steps.title: Let one step through

steps.caption: The channel Trig Probability is 100 before step 1 receives its own lock.
steps.title: Confirm the channel value before the local edit

steps.caption: While step 1 is held, the Trig Probability slot reads 0 with an L marker.
steps.title: Confirm the first-step rest lock

steps.caption: After step 1 is released, the channel probability remains 100.
steps.title: Confirm the channel value after release

steps.caption: With no step held, turn E3 up to 100 again. Hold step 1 at (1,4), turn E3 all the way down and one detent up to 0, and release. A lock of 0 beats the channel's 100. Tap Play: step 1 is silent and steps 2, 3 and 4 sound.
steps.title: Reject one step

steps.caption: While step 4 is held, the Trig Probability slot reads 0 with an L marker.
steps.title: Confirm the wrap-step rest lock

steps.caption: After step 4 is released, the channel probability remains 100.
steps.title: Confirm the channel value after release

steps.caption: Hold step 4 at (4,4), set its lock to 0 the same way and release. Tap Play: steps 2 and 3 sound; steps 1 and 4 are silent.
steps.title: Reject a second step

steps.caption: Hold step 1, press K2 and release. Tap Play: steps 1, 2 and 3 sound, and step 4 is still silent. Then hold step 4, press K2 and release. Tap Play: all four steps sound again.
steps.title: Clear both locks
